test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In Which year did the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare of India launch the Weekly Iron and Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFS) program to meet the challenge of high prevalence and incidence of anaemia among adolescent girls and boys (56% girls and 30% boys)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2012**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **World Health Organization, weekly iron and folic acid supplements (WIFS) **are recognized as a crucial intervention to combat anaemia.
 
• In response to the high prevalence and incidence of anaemia among **adolescent girls and boys in India (56% of girls and 30% of boys),** the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare launched the **Weekly Iron and Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFS) **programme in **2012.**
 
• WIFS is evidence-based and involves weekly supervised ingestion of iron and folic acid supplements, along with bi-annual helminthic control.
 
• These interventions are supported by a comprehensive communication program aimed at raising awareness and enhancing knowledge about anaemia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The program** aims** to break the intergenerational cycle of anaemia in the long term **and improve India's human capital through better nutrition status in the short term.
 
• Implemented nationwide in both rural and urban areas, the WIFS programme serves 108 million beneficiaries, with 75% being in-school and the remaining out-of-school.
 
• Dr. Sushma Dureja presented an overview of the WIFS approach during a webinar, highlighting its challenges, achievements, and success factors.
